_doc: N7RT runtime image for NUCLEO-G0B1RE (STM32G0B1RE, Cortex-M0+), distributed in the student SDK n7rt_g0b1/. 'stm32lab sdk --family g0b1' takes the runtime region of the runtime build (firmware/stm32_g0b1_runtime, preset runtime: sources in the instructor repository only, never in the student repository) and refuses it unless its SHA-256, size and build id are exactly these. Same N7RT-Link v0 and ABI 1.0 as the H753 runtime (runtime-release.json). Bump this file only with new hardware evidence.
toolchain: Arm GNU Toolchain 14.3.Rel1 (arm-none-eabi-gcc 14.3.1 20250623), CMake preset runtime (Release, -O2)
